title: Massachusetts Schedule II patient-request remainder
rule_summary: Only the pharmacy that made the initial patient-requested Schedule II partial fill may dispense the remainder, and the remainder must be filled no later than 30 days after issue.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply remainder deadline requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing remainder deadline with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
